narr: Deep monsoon moisture over northern Arizona brought thunderstorms with heavy rain and flash flooding.
ev: The steam gauge on Agua Fria River near Cordes Junction showed a 3.47 foot rise.
A stream gauge on the Wet Beaver Creek measured a 2.15 foot rise.
A stream gauge on Dry Beaver Creek showed a 1.55 foot rise.
Heavy rain caused a 2.2 foot rise in Newman Canyon which flows into Upper Lake Mary.

Heavy rain over the Schultz Fire scar (2010) and the Tunnel/Pipeline Fire scar (2022) caused flooding over a driveway near Glodia Drive and Copland Lane. A large debris flow was also seen at the intersection of Campbell Avenue and Henry Drive.
